## Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: packages

library(here)
library(nlme)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2) 
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(jtools)
library(haven)
library(modsem)
library(forecast)
library(gt)
```

## Load Data

The merged baseline warmth SPSS dataset produced by the import pipeline (see the Baseline Warmth Import page) is read in from the project's computed-data folder. Import code is included but not rendered below.

```{r}
#| label: load data
#| echo: false

BL_WH <- read_sav("C:/Users/rcm5550/Box/ff (cast.casbox )/DATA & SYNTAX/COMPUTED DATA/Baseline/Observed couple relationship/BL_WH.sav")
```

```{r}
#| label: preview-dataset
#| echo: false
#| eval: false

# Row-level preview suppressed for the public site since it would print
# real values even with the code hidden. Flip eval to true to preview locally.
knitr::kable(head(BL_WH, n = 5)[1:6], caption = "Raw Baseline Warmth Data")
```

## Transformation

```{r}
#| label: wide to long

#transform data wide to long
BL_WH_WidetoLong <- BL_WH %>%
  pivot_longer(
    #select columns like blmnwh.6, blmnwh.7, etc.
    cols = matches("^[^.]+\\.\\d+$"), 
    
    #split variable name based on period
    names_to = c(".value", "second"),  
    names_sep = "\\." ) %>%
  
  #convert second to numeric
  mutate(second = as.numeric(second))
```

```{r}
#| label: missing data

#select four warmth variables, second, ID
BL_WH_Long <- BL_WH_WidetoLong %>%
  select(ID, second, blmnwh, blmpwh, blfnwh, blfpwh)

#set 0 as missing
BL_WH_Long$blmnwh[BL_WH_Long$blmnwh == 0] <- NA
BL_WH_Long$blmpwh[BL_WH_Long$blmpwh == 0] <- NA
BL_WH_Long$blfnwh[BL_WH_Long$blfnwh == 0] <- NA
BL_WH_Long$blfpwh[BL_WH_Long$blfpwh == 0] <- NA

#preview dataset
knitr::kable(head(BL_WH_Long, 5), caption = "Long Baseline Warmth Data")
```

```{r}
#| label: create negative interaction dataset

#create long format for negative interaction 
##(blmnwh = mom, blfnwh = partner)

BL_WH_Neg_Long <- BL_WH_Long %>%
  select(ID, second, blmnwh, blfnwh) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(blmnwh, blfnwh),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "blnwh") %>%
  mutate(
    personF = case_when(
      source == "blmnwh" ~ "mom",        #mom
      source == "blfnwh" ~ "partner" ),  #partner
    personN = case_when(
      source == "blmnwh" ~ 1,    #mom
      source == "blfnwh" ~ 2 ))  #partner 

#set personF as factor
BL_WH_Neg_Long$personF <- as.factor(BL_WH_Neg_Long$personF)

#set personN as factor
BL_WH_Neg_Long$personN <- as.numeric(BL_WH_Neg_Long$personN)

#preview dataset
knitr::kable(head(BL_WH_Neg_Long, 20), caption = "Long Baseline Warmth Negative Interaction Data")
```

```{r}
#| label: create positive interaction dataset

#create long format for positive interaction 
##(blmpwh = mom, blfpwh = partner)

BL_WH_Pos_Long <- BL_WH_Long %>%
  select(ID, second, blmpwh, blfpwh) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(blmpwh, blfpwh),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "blpwh") %>%
  mutate(
    personF = case_when(
      source == "blmpwh" ~ "mom",        #mom
      source == "blfpwh" ~ "partner" ),  #partner
    personN = case_when(
      source == "blmpwh" ~ 1,    #mom
      source == "blfpwh" ~ 2 ))  #partner 

#set personF as factor
BL_WH_Pos_Long$personF <- as.factor(BL_WH_Pos_Long$personF)

#set personN as factor
BL_WH_Pos_Long$personN <- as.numeric(BL_WH_Pos_Long$personN)

#preview dataset
knitr::kable(head(BL_WH_Pos_Long, 20), caption = "Long Baseline Warmth Negative Interaction Data")
```

These three long-format datasets (`BL_WH_Long`, `BL_WH_Pos_Long`, `BL_WH_Neg_Long`) are not re-exported here; the [Baseline Synchrony Calculation](Baseline-Synchrony_Calculation.qmd) page reads the same processed data from where it's already saved.

## Panel Plots

@fig-blnegative-warmth: Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion

```{r}
#| label: fig-blnegative-warmth
#| fig-cap: "Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion"
#| code-fold: true

fig_blnegative_warmth <- ggplot(data = BL_WH_Neg_Long, aes(second, blnwh, color = personF)) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("mom" = "#CC6677", "partner" = "#88CCEE"), name = "Person") +
  labs(title = "Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion",
       caption = "Smoothed trend of second-by-second negative-discussion warmth ratings by person (mom vs. partner), averaged across couples.") +
  xlab("Time") +
  ylab("Value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
fig_blnegative_warmth
ggsave("../../figures/baseline-warmth-synchrony/processing/fig-blnegative-warmth.png", plot = fig_blnegative_warmth, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

@fig-blpositive-warmth: Couple Warmth During Positive Discussion

```{r}
#| label: fig-blpositive-warmth
#| fig-cap: "Couple Warmth During Positive Discussion"

fig_blpositive_warmth <- ggplot(data = BL_WH_Pos_Long, aes(second, blpwh, color = personF)) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("mom" = "#CC6677", "partner" = "#88CCEE"), name = "Person") +
  labs(title = "Couple Warmth During Positive Discussion",
       caption = "Smoothed trend of second-by-second positive-discussion warmth ratings by person (mom vs. partner), averaged across couples.") +
  xlab("Time") +
  ylab("Value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
fig_blpositive_warmth
ggsave("../../figures/baseline-warmth-synchrony/processing/fig-blpositive-warmth.png", plot = fig_blpositive_warmth, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: create-subset-for-plots

#create filtered dataset for plot

BL_WH_Neg_Long_Filtered <- BL_WH_Neg_Long %>%
  filter(ID %in% c(110, 112, 149, 162, 172, 178, 175, 182, 183, 209, 246, 254, 279, 303))

BL_WH_Pos_Long_Filtered <- BL_WH_Pos_Long %>%
  filter(ID %in% c(110, 112, 149, 162, 172, 178, 175, 182, 183, 209, 246, 254, 279, 303))
```

@fig-blnegative-warmth-subset: Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion

```{r}
#| label: fig-blnegative-warmth-subset
#| fig-cap: "Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion"

fig_blnegative_warmth_subset <- ggplot(data = BL_WH_Neg_Long_Filtered %>% filter(ID %in% head(unique(ID), 3)), aes(second, blnwh, color = personF)) +
  geom_line(lwd = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("mom" = "#CC6677", "partner" = "#88CCEE"), name = "Person") +
  labs(title = "Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion (Sample Couples)",
       caption = "Second-by-second negative-discussion warmth ratings by person, for a sample of 3 couples.") +
  xlab("Time - 0 to 600 seconds") +
  ylab("No (1) to High Warmth (7)") +
  facet_wrap(~ ID, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
fig_blnegative_warmth_subset
ggsave("../../figures/baseline-warmth-synchrony/processing/fig-blnegative-warmth-subset.png", plot = fig_blnegative_warmth_subset, width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

@fig-blpositive-warmth-subset: Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion

```{r}

#| fig-cap: "Couple Warmth During Positive Discussion"

fig_blpositive_warmth_subset <- ggplot(data = BL_WH_Pos_Long_Filtered %>% filter(ID %in% head(unique(ID), 3)), aes(second, blpwh, color = personF)) +
  geom_line(lwd = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("mom" = "#CC6677", "partner" = "#88CCEE"), name = "Person") +
  labs(title = "Couple Warmth During Positive Discussion (Sample Couples)",
       caption = "Second-by-second positive-discussion warmth ratings by person, for a sample of 3 couples.") +
  xlab("Time - 0 to 600 seconds") +
  ylab("No (1) to High Warmth (7)") +
  facet_wrap(~ ID, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
fig_blpositive_warmth_subset
ggsave("../../figures/baseline-warmth-synchrony/processing/fig-blpositive-warmth-subset.png", plot = fig_blpositive_warmth_subset, width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300)
